source_isolation: verify_access_distribution creates no-system-site-packages venvs outside checkout, installs each wheel with --no-deps, removes PYTHONPATH and executes python -I; this is real installed smoke, not source-overlay execution.
installed_test_scope: Finite Access registry/configuration/workflow/local actual Git/backup/fork and Context SQL/Exchange smoke, not the complete selected pytest cohort in installed packages.
documentation_scope: Existing explicit staged site sources, only ADR0001/0002 from docs/adr; --no-mermaid emits placeholders, no deployment command. Internal Access/ADR0029 prose is not covered by that site build.
